import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier

digits = load_digits()
X, y = digits.data / 16, digits.target
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
model = MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,), alpha=1e-3, max_iter=500, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)

def shift_right(X):
    imgs = np.roll(X.reshape(-1, 8, 8), 1, axis=2)
    imgs[:, :, 0] = 0
    return imgs.reshape(-1, 64)


X_fit, X_val, y_fit, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=7, stratify=y_train)
def fit_model(rows, labels, augment=False):
    if augment:
        rows, labels = np.vstack([rows, shift_right(rows)]), np.tile(labels, 2)
    return MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,), alpha=1e-3, max_iter=500, random_state=0).fit(rows, labels)

augmented = fit_model(X_fit, y_fit, True).predict(right)
acc_shift = round((plain.argmax(1) == y_val).mean(), 3)
acc_aug = round((augmented == y_val).mean(), 3)
defense = "augment" if acc_aug > acc_shift else "plain"
example_idx = int(np.flatnonzero((plain.argmax(1) != y_val) & (plain.max(1) >= .9))[0])
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots()

ax.set_title(f"Цифра {y_val[example_idx]}, прогноз {plain[example_idx].argmax()}, p={plain[example_idx].max():.2f}")
final = fit_model(X_train, y_train, defense == "augment")
left = np.zeros_like(X_test.reshape(-1,8,8))
left[:, :, :-1] = X_test.reshape(-1,8,8)[:, :, 1:]
holdout_accuracy = round((final.predict(left.reshape(-1,64)) == y_test).mean(), 3)
print(acc_shift, acc_aug, defense, holdout_accuracy)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import re as _blur_re
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier

def _prepare_blur_transfer():
    digits = load_digits()
    ids = np.arange(len(digits.target))
    development, holdout = train_test_split(ids, test_size=.25, random_state=42, stratify=digits.target)
    fit, val = train_test_split(development, test_size=.25, random_state=7, stratify=digits.target[development])
    def batch(train, other):
        model = MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,), alpha=1e-3, max_iter=500, random_state=0).fit(digits.data[train]/16, digits.target[train])
        images = gaussian_filter(digits.images[other]/16, sigma=(0,.65,.65), mode="constant", cval=0)
        return images, model.predict_proba(images.reshape(-1,64))
    val_images, val_proba = batch(fit,val)
    blind_images, blind_proba = batch(development,holdout)
    val_target, holdout_target = digits.target[val].copy(), digits.target[holdout].copy()
    state = {}
    def ordered_queue(rule, proba):
        top = np.sort(proba,axis=1)
        score = top[:,-1] if rule=="confidence" else top[:,-1]-top[:,-2]
        return np.lexsort((np.arange(len(proba)),score))[:37]
    def open_labels(example, rule_name, queue, reason):
        assert isinstance(example,dict), 'До меток сохраните example — словарь с разбором уверенной ошибки валидации.'
        for name in ('position','truth','prediction','confidence','observation'):
            assert name in example, f'В example нет поля {name}.'
        i=example['position']
        assert isinstance(i,(int,np.integer)) and 0<=i<len(val_target), 'position — целая позиция внутри validation.'
        pred=int(val_proba[i].argmax()); confidence=float(val_proba[i].max())
        assert pred!=val_target[i] and confidence>=.9, 'Выберите уверенную ошибку на валидации, а не правильный или неуверенный ответ.'
        assert example['truth']==val_target[i] and example['prediction']==pred and np.isclose(example['confidence'],confidence,rtol=0,atol=.0051), 'В example сверьте истинную цифру, прогноз и уверенность выбранной позиции.'
        assert isinstance(example['observation'],str) and len(example['observation'].strip())>=15, 'Добавьте своё наблюдение о видимом затруднении чтения; не ограничивайтесь номером класса.'
        image_axes=[ax for number in plt.get_fignums() for ax in plt.figure(number).axes if any(im.get_visible() and np.shape(im.get_array())==(8,8) and np.allclose(im.get_array(),val_images[i]) for im in ax.images)]
        assert image_axes, 'До открытия меток покажите размытое изображение выбранной ошибки валидации.'
        def caption_error(title):
            # Match named values, rather than one literal Russian sentence.
            text=title.casefold().replace("ё","е")
            fields=[('position/позиция',r'position|позиция|id',i,0),
                    ('truth/истина',r'truth|true|истина|(?:истинная|верная)\s+цифра',int(val_target[i]),0),
                    ('prediction/прогноз',r'prediction|pred|прогноз',pred,0),
                    ('confidence/уверенность',r'confidence|уверенность|вероятность|p',confidence,.0051)]
            number=r'([+-]?(?:\d+(?:[.,]\d*)?|[.,]\d+)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?)(\s*%)?'
            for name,aliases,expected,tolerance in fields:
                matches=_blur_re.findall(r'(?<!\w)(?:'+aliases+r')(?!\w)\s*[:=]?\s*'+number,text)
                if len(matches)!=1:
                    return f'поле {name} отсутствует или указано неоднозначно'
                value=float(matches[0][0].replace(",","."))
                if matches[0][1]:
                    if name!='confidence/уверенность':return f'поле {name} не выражается в процентах'
                    value/=100
                if not np.isfinite(value) or not np.isclose(value,expected,rtol=0,atol=tolerance):
                    return f'{name}={value:g}, а у выбранного примера {expected:g}'
            return None
        caption_errors=[caption_error(ax.get_title()) for ax in image_axes]
        assert any(error is None for error in caption_errors), 'Подпись выбранного примера: '+caption_errors[0]+'. Используйте русские или английские названия четырёх полей: позиция, истина, прогноз, уверенность.'
        assert rule_name in ('confidence','margin'), 'rule_name — confidence или margin; правило фиксируется до меток.'
        assert isinstance(reason,str) and len(reason.strip())>=15, 'Запишите rule_reason: почему выбрали это правило очереди.'
        q=np.asarray(queue)
        assert q.shape==(37,) and np.issubdtype(q.dtype,np.integer) and len(np.unique(q))==37 and (q>=0).all() and (q<len(holdout)).all(), 'queue — ровно 37 разных целых позиций второй партии.'
        expected=ordered_queue(rule_name,blind_proba)
        assert np.array_equal(q,expected), 'Очередь не соответствует записанному правилу. Сначала меньший score, при равенстве меньшая позиция; используйте blind.proba, без меток.'
        if state:
            assert state['rule']==rule_name and state['queue']==tuple(int(v) for v in q), 'Метки уже открыты: правило и очередь этой попытки зафиксированы.'
        else:
            state.update(rule=rule_name, queue=tuple(int(v) for v in q), reason=reason, example=dict(example))
        return holdout_target.copy()
    def assessment_after_open():
        assert state, "Сначала зафиксируйте пример, правило и очередь через open_blur_labels."
        return holdout_target.copy(), blind_proba.copy()
    # Labels stay in the closure until the queue has been saved.
    return dict(images=val_images.copy(),proba=val_proba.copy(),target=val_target.copy()), dict(images=blind_images.copy(),proba=blind_proba.copy()), open_labels, state, assessment_after_open

import pandas as pd
s = pd.read_csv("app_orders.csv", parse_dates=["datetime"], index_col="datetime")["orders"]

def leak_test(features, s, t):

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor
s = pd.read_csv("app_orders.csv", parse_dates=["datetime"], index_col="datetime")["orders"]
s = s[s.index < '2026-08-01']
promo_days = pd.to_datetime(["2026-04-17", "2026-05-22", "2026-06-19", "2026-07-24", "2026-08-21"])

def make_promo(index):
    flags = index.normalize().isin(promo_days) & (index.hour >= 10) & (index.hour <= 20)
    return pd.Series(flags.astype(int), index=index)

df = make_features(s)
df["promo"] = make_promo(df.index)
train = df.index < "2026-07-01"
y = df["y"]
base_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ("y", "promo")]

def rmse(a, b):
    return float(np.sqrt(((a - b) ** 2).mean()))

p_without = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=0).fit(df.loc[train, base_cols], y[train]).predict(df.loc[~train, base_cols])
p_with = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=0).fit(df.loc[train, base_cols + ["promo"]], y[train]).predict(df.loc[~train, base_cols + ["promo"]])
y_test = y[~train].values
test_idx = df.index[~train]
promo_mask = (test_idx.normalize() == pd.Timestamp("2026-07-24")) & (test_idx.hour >= 10) & (test_idx.hour <= 20)
rmse_without = round(rmse(y_test, p_without), 3)
rmse_with = round(rmse(y_test, p_with), 3)
promo_without = round(rmse(y_test[promo_mask], p_without[promo_mask]), 3)
promo_with = round(rmse(y_test[promo_mask], p_with[promo_mask]), 3)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

tf = TfidfVectorizer()
T = tf.fit_transform(r["text"])
names = tf.get_feature_names_out()

def keywords(i, k=3):
    row = T[i].toarray()[0]
    idx = [j for j in np.argsort(-row, kind="stable") if row[j] > 0][:k]
    return [str(names[j]) for j in idx]

kw = {i: keywords(i) for i in range(5)}
share_topic_word = round(float(np.mean([bool(set(keywords(i)) & MARKERS[r.loc[i, "topic"]]) for i in range(200)])), 3)
print(kw, share_topic_word)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import cohen_kappa_score
wide = pd.read_csv("review_labels.csv").pivot(index="review_id", columns="annotator", values="label")

def kappa(x, y):
    x, y = list(x), list(y)
    n = len(x)
    p_o = sum(a == b for a, b in zip(x, y)) / n
    p_e = sum((x.count(c) / n) * (y.count(c) / n) for c in set(x) | set(y))
    return (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e)

kappa_ab = round(kappa(wide["аня"], wide["борис"]), 3)
kappa_av = round(kappa(wide["аня"], wide["вика"]), 3)
print(kappa_ab, kappa_av, round(cohen_kappa_score(wide["аня"], wide["вика"]), 3))

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline

from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD

acc_by_k = {}
for k in [10, 20, 50, 100]:
    m = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(), TruncatedSVD(k, random_state=0), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))
    acc_by_k[k] = round(accuracy_score(y_test, m.fit(X_train, y_train).predict(X_test)), 3)
full = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_train, y_train)
acc_full = round(accuracy_score(y_test, full.predict(X_test)), 3)
best_k = max(sorted(acc_by_k), key=acc_by_k.get)
print(acc_by_k, acc_full, best_k)

def wordpiece(word):
    pieces, start = [], 0

        end = len(word)

            piece = word[start:end] if start == 0 else "##" + word[start:end]
            if piece in ID:
                break
            end -= 1
        if end == start:                           # ни один кусок не подошёл
            return ["[UNK]"]
        pieces.append(piece)
        start = end
    return pieces

def encode(text):
    tokens = ["[CLS]"] + [p for w in text.lower().split() for p in wordpiece(w)] + ["[SEP]"]
    return tokens, [ID[t] for t in tokens]

def pad_count(lens, size=8):
    total = 0
    for i in range(0, len(lens), size):
        chunk = lens[i:i + size]
        total += max(chunk) * len(chunk) - sum(chunk)
    return total

pad_plain = pad_count(lens)

saved = round(1 - pad_sorted / pad_plain, 3)

from sklearn.metrics import f1_score

    for subset, fit_ids, test_ids in [("повторы", train, test[repeated]),
                                     ("новые", train, test[~repeated]),
                                     ("без пересечения", group_train, group_test)]:

                truth, predicted, average="macro", labels=sorted(target.unique()), zero_division=0), 3)
print(text_quality)

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")
y = (r["rating"] <= 3).astype(int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(r["text"], y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
pred = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2)), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_train, y_train).predict(X_test)
tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y_test, pred).ravel()
tpr, fpr = tp / (tp + fn), fp / (fp + tn)

obs = n[n["shop_id"] == "KZN-2"].groupby("period")["neg"].mean()
adj = {k: round((obs[k] - fpr) / (tpr - fpr), 3) for k in ["до", "после"]}
print(round(tpr, 3), round(fpr, 3), obs.round(3).to_dict(), adj)
gold = pd.read_csv('reviews_new_gold.csv')
labeled = n.merge(gold[['review_id','complaint']],on='review_id',validate='one_to_one')
rows=[]
for period,part in labeled[labeled.shop_id=='KZN-2'].groupby('period'):
    target=part.complaint
    tpr_new=float(part.loc[target==1,'neg'].mean())
    fpr_new=float(part.loc[target==0,'neg'].mean())
    observed=float(part.neg.mean())
    rows.append(dict(period=period,n=len(part),complaints=int(target.sum()),tpr=tpr_new,fpr=fpr_new,observed=observed,manual=float(target.mean()),adjusted=(observed-fpr_new)/(tpr_new-fpr_new) if abs(tpr_new-fpr_new)>1e-6 else float("nan")))
audit=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('period')

import io
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

X = np.load("showcase.npz")["X"]

def roundtrip(img, fmt, **opts):
    """Сохранить картинку в память и прочитать обратно: (размер в байтах, массив)."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    Image.fromarray(img).save(buf, format=fmt, **opts)
    data = buf.getvalue()
    return len(data), np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)))

size_png = size_jpeg = 0
errors, same = [], []
for img in X[:100]:
    n, back = roundtrip(img, "PNG")
    size_png += n
    same.append(np.array_equal(back, img))
    n, back = roundtrip(img, "JPEG", quality=75)
    size_jpeg += n
    errors.append(np.abs(back.astype(int) - img.astype(int)))

raw = X[:100].nbytes
share_png = round(size_png / raw, 3)
share_jpeg = round(size_jpeg / raw, 3)
mae_jpeg = round(float(np.mean(errors)), 2)
lossless = all(same)
print(share_png, share_jpeg, mae_jpeg, lossless)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import ndimage as ndi

ratio = []
for z in X:
    b = ndi.correlate(z, BLUR, mode="nearest")
    vert = np.abs(ndi.correlate(b, SX, mode="nearest")).sum()
    horiz = np.abs(ndi.correlate(b, SX.T, mode="nearest")).sum()

import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

d = np.load("showcase.npz")
X, y = d["X"] / 255, d["y"]
tr, te = train_test_split(np.arange(len(X)), test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

def augment(Z, labels, rng):
    flipped = Z[:, :, ::-1]
    shifts = rng.integers(-4, 5, size=(len(Z), 2))
    shifted = np.stack([np.roll(z, tuple(s), axis=(0, 1)) for z, s in zip(Z, shifts)])
    return np.concatenate([Z, flipped, shifted]), np.concatenate([labels, labels, labels])

aug = RandomForestClassifier(100, random_state=0).fit(flat(X_aug), y_aug)
print("без аугментации:", round(base.score(flat(X[te]), y[te]), 3))
print("с аугментацией: ", round(aug.score(flat(X[te]), y[te]), 3))

def out_size(n, k, pad=0, stride=1):
    return (n + 2 * pad - k) // stride + 1

def iou(a, b):
    """IoU двух рамок (x1, y1, x2, y2); x1 < x2, y1 < y2."""
    w = min(a[2], b[2]) - max(a[0], b[0])          # ширина пересечения
    h = min(a[3], b[3]) - max(a[1], b[1])          # высота пересечения
    inter = max(0, w) * max(0, h)                   # не пересеклись — 0, а не «минус»
    area = lambda r: (r[2] - r[0]) * (r[3] - r[1])
    return inter / (area(a) + area(b) - inter)

import pandas as pd

def alert_table(frame, k=2):
    empty = frame.pivot(index="time", columns="slot", values="pred").eq(0)
    ticks = pd.date_range("2000-01-01 " + empty.index.min(),
                          "2000-01-01 " + empty.index.max(), freq="15min")
    empty = empty.reindex(ticks.strftime("%H:%M"), fill_value=False)
    empty.index.name = "time"
    confirmed = empty.copy()
    for lag in range(1, k):
        confirmed &= empty.shift(lag, fill_value=False)
    return confirmed & ~confirmed.shift(fill_value=False)


P = df.pivot(index="time", columns="slot", values="pred").eq(0)
T = df.pivot(index="time", columns="slot", values="true").eq(0)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

def release_check(model, card, golden_path, X_test, y_test):
    gold = pd.read_csv(golden_path)
    diff = np.abs(model.predict_proba(gold.drop(columns=["expected"]))[:, 1] - gold["expected"]).max()
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1])
    return {
        "features": [str(f) for f in model.feature_names_in_] == list(card["features"]),
        "golden": bool(diff < 1e-9),
        "auc": bool(auc >= card["auc_test"] - 0.01),
    }

res_good = release_check(good, card, "golden.csv", X_test, y_test)
res_bad = release_check(retrained, card, "golden.csv", X_test, y_test)
print(res_good, res_bad, sep="\n")

import pandas as pd

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline, make_pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
X = g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"])
NUM = ["tenure_months", "app", "visits_90d", "days_since_last", "avg_check", "delivery_share", "promo_used", "complaints"]
CAT = ["city", "fav_category"]
pre = ColumnTransformer([("num", make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy="median"), StandardScaler()), NUM),
                         ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), CAT)])
model = Pipeline([("prep", pre), ("model", LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000))]).fit(X, g["churned"])
CARD = {"version": "1.0", "features": list(X.columns), "threshold": 1 / 3}

def is_int(x):                                     # как в разделе «Проверка входа»: True не пройдёт
    return isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)

def validate(p):                                   # сокращённая версия: наличие полей и одно целое поле
    errors = [f"{f}: обязательное поле" for f in CARD["features"] if f not in p]
    if not errors and not (is_int(p["visits_90d"]) and p["visits_90d"] >= 0):
        errors.append("visits_90d: ожидается целое ≥ 0")
    return errors

def predict_one(payload):
    errors = validate(payload)
    if errors:
        return {"status": 422, "errors": errors}
    try:
        row = pd.DataFrame([payload])[CARD["features"]]
        p = float(model.predict_proba(row)[0, 1])
    except Exception as e:                         # непредвиденная поломка — честно 500
        return {"status": 500, "errors": [f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"]}
    return {"status": 200, "proba": round(p, 3), "in_campaign": p >= CARD["threshold"],
            "model_version": CARD["version"]}

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def explain_one(payload, k=2):
    prep = model.named_steps["prep"]
    lr = model.named_steps["model"]
    z = prep.transform(pd.DataFrame([payload])[FEATURES])
    z = z.toarray() if hasattr(z, "toarray") else np.asarray(z)
    names = [n.split("__", 1)[1] for n in prep.get_feature_names_out()]
    contrib = pd.Series(z[0] * lr.coef_[0], index=names)
    contrib = contrib[contrib > 0].sort_values(ascending=False)
    return list(contrib.index[:k])

top_guest = explain_one(GUEST)
print(top_guest)

import json
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

def rebuild(row):
    params = json.loads(row["params"])
    if row["model"] == "LogReg":
        return LogisticRegression(**params)
    return RandomForestClassifier(**params, random_state=int(row["seed"]))

rows = []
for _, row in journal.iterrows():
    rep = round(cross_val_score(make(rebuild(row)), X_train, y_train, cv=CV, scoring="roc_auc").mean(), 4)
    rows.append({"run_id": row["run_id"], "logged": row["cv_auc_mean"], "reproduced": rep,
                 "ok": abs(rep - row["cv_auc_mean"]) < 0.0005})
check_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
broken = check_df.loc[~check_df["ok"], "run_id"].iloc[0]
print(check_df)

import os
import pandas as pd

def bad_reason(row):
    if row["visits_90d"] < 0:
        return "visits_90d < 0"
    if not 0 <= row["delivery_share"] <= 1:
        return "delivery_share вне 0–1"
    if row["tenure_months"] < 1:
        return "tenure_months < 1"
    return ""

def run_batch(input_path, out_dir, date):
    df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

    good = df[reasons == ""]

    p = MODEL.predict_proba(good[CARD["features"]])[:, 1]
    out = pd.DataFrame({"guest_id": good["guest_id"], "proba": p.round(4),
                        "in_campaign": p >= CARD["threshold"], "model_version": CARD["version"]})
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    out.to_csv(f"{out_dir}/scores_{date}.csv", index=False)
    bad.to_csv(f"{out_dir}/rejected_{date}.csv", index=False)
    return {"date": date, "n_input": len(df), "n_scored": len(out), "n_rejected": len(bad),
            "n_in_campaign": int(out["in_campaign"].sum())}

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

rows = []
for n in [150, 60, 20]:
    m = make(RandomForestClassifier(n, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0)).fit(X_train, y_train)

def order_features(cutoff):

from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

X, y, groups = train[CAT + NUM], train["churn"], train["client_id"]
models = {
    "logreg": make_pipeline(_pre(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)),
    "boosting": make_pipeline(ColumnTransformer([("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), CAT)], remainder="passthrough"),
                              HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, random_state=42)),
    "knn": make_pipeline(_pre(), KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=25)),
}
cv = GroupKFold(n_splits=5)
cv_auc = {k: round(float(cross_val_score(m, X, y, groups=groups, cv=cv, scoring="roc_auc").mean()), 3)
          for k, m in models.items()}
best = max(cv_auc, key=cv_auc.get)
final = models[best].fit(X, y)
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict
# Каждая вероятность получена моделью, для которой этот офис был отложен целиком.
oof = cross_val_predict(models[best], X, y, groups=groups, cv=cv, method="predict_proba")[:, 1]
past = train.assign(risk=oof, bin=pd.qcut(oof, 5, duplicates="drop"))
oof_calibration = past.groupby("bin", observed=True).agg(offices=("client_id", "size"), risk=("risk", "mean"), churn=("churn", "mean"))
r = past["revenue_90"] / 3
gain = past["risk"] * .5 * .35 * 12 * r - 1500 - .2 * r
historical_budget = past.assign(eligible=gain.gt(0), expected=gain).groupby("cutoff").apply(
    lambda quarter: quarter.loc[quarter["eligible"], "expected"].nlargest(150).sum())
print(oof_calibration.round(3), historical_budget.round())
test_auc = round(float(roc_auc_score(test["churn"], final.predict_proba(test[CAT + NUM])[:, 1])), 3)
print(cv_auc, best, test_auc)

import sqlite3
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
_con = sqlite3.connect("office.db")
clients = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM clients", _con)
contracts = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM contracts", _con, parse_dates=["start_date", "end_date"])
orders = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM orders", _con, parse_dates=["order_date"])
tickets = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM tickets", _con, parse_dates=["created_at"]).drop_duplicates("ticket_id")
invoices = pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM invoices", _con, parse_dates=["due_date", "paid_date"])
_con.close()
base = clients[clients["is_test"] == 0].merge(contracts, on="client_id")

def active_at(cutoff):
    c = pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
    return base[(base["start_date"] <= c) & (base["end_date"].isna() | (base["end_date"] > c))]

def build_target(cutoff, months=3):
    c = pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
    act = active_at(c)
    y = act["end_date"].notna() & (act["end_date"] <= c + pd.offsets.MonthEnd(months))
    return pd.Series(y.astype(int).values, index=act["client_id"].values, name="churn")

def build_features(cutoff):
    c = pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
    act = active_at(c).set_index("client_id")
    f = act[["employees", "has_manager", "own_machine", "plan", "city"]].copy()
    f["industry"] = act["industry"].fillna("нет данных")
    f["tenure_days"] = (c - act["start_date"]).dt.days
    o = orders[(orders["order_date"] <= c) & (orders["status"] != "отменён")]
    o90 = o[o["order_date"] > c - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    prev = o[(o["order_date"] > c - pd.Timedelta(days=180)) & (o["order_date"] <= c - pd.Timedelta(days=90))]
    f["orders_90"] = o90.groupby("client_id").size().reindex(f.index, fill_value=0)
    f["revenue_90"] = o90.groupby("client_id")["amount"].sum().reindex(f.index, fill_value=0)
    rev_prev = prev.groupby("client_id")["amount"].sum().reindex(f.index, fill_value=0)
    f["revenue_trend"] = (f["revenue_90"] - rev_prev) / (f["revenue_90"] + rev_prev + 1)
    last = o.groupby("client_id")["order_date"].max().reindex(f.index)
    f["days_since_order"] = (c - last).dt.days.fillna(f["tenure_days"])
    late = (o90[o90["status"] == "доставлен"]["late_min"] > 0).groupby(o90["client_id"]).mean()
    f["late_share_90"] = late.reindex(f.index).fillna(0)
    t90 = tickets[(tickets["created_at"] <= c) & (tickets["created_at"] > c - pd.Timedelta(days=90))]
    f["tickets_90"] = t90.groupby("client_id").size().reindex(f.index, fill_value=0)
    f["tickets_bill_90"] = t90[t90["category"] == "счёт"].groupby("client_id").size().reindex(f.index, fill_value=0)
    iv = invoices[invoices["due_date"] <= c].sort_values("due_date").copy()
    paid = iv["paid_date"].where(iv["paid_date"] <= c)
    iv["days_late"] = (paid.fillna(c) - iv["due_date"]).dt.days.clip(lower=0)
    iv["overdue"] = (paid.isna() & (iv["due_date"] < c)).astype(int)
    f["pay_late_last3"] = iv.groupby("client_id").tail(3).groupby("client_id")["days_late"].mean().reindex(f.index).fillna(0)
    f["overdue_now"] = iv.groupby("client_id")["overdue"].sum().reindex(f.index, fill_value=0)
    return f

def snapshot(cutoff):
    f = build_features(cutoff)
    if pd.Timestamp(cutoff) + pd.offsets.MonthEnd(3) <= pd.Timestamp("2026-09-30"):
        f["churn"] = build_target(cutoff).reindex(f.index)
    f["cutoff"] = pd.Timestamp(cutoff)
    return f.reset_index()

NUM = ["employees", "has_manager", "own_machine", "tenure_days", "orders_90", "revenue_90", "revenue_trend",

train = pd.concat([snapshot(c) for c in ["2025-09-30", "2025-12-31", "2026-03-31"]], ignore_index=True)

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
def _pre():
    return ColumnTransformer([("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), CAT), ("num", StandardScaler(), NUM)])
